title: Non-KKT Accumulation in Entropic Mirror Descent
abstract: arXiv:2608.01658v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: For mirror descent generated by a Legendre kernel, perhaps one of the most basic question in optimization is this: must every accumulation point of a bounded mirror descent sequence be Karush--Kuhn--Tucker (KKT) stationary under proper stepsizes? We show that the answer is no. A longstanding obstacle to resolving this question is the boundary blow-up of the Legendre gradient: it keeps every mirror step in the interior, while at a boundary limit, the inverse entropy metric vanishes on active coordinates and can erase the dual-feasibility in the KKT system. We construct $C^\infty$ objectives and bounded sequences generated by the Shannon-entropic mirror descent on the nonnegative orthant $\R_+^n$, for every $n\geq 3$, and on the probability simplex $\Delta_n$, for every $n\geq 4$, such that, in each case, the set of accumulation points is a smooth boundary circle containing a nonempty relatively open arc of non-KKT points. translated_title: 熵镜像下降中的非KKT累积点
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.01658v2 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：对于由勒让德核生成的镜像下降，优化中最基本的问题之一可能是：在适当的步长下，有界镜像下降序列的每个累积点是否都必须是Karush--Kuhn--Tucker（KKT）平稳点？我们证明答案是否定的。解决这个问题的一个长期障碍是勒让德梯度的边界爆炸：它使每个镜像步骤保持在内部，而在边界极限处，逆熵度量在活动坐标上消失，可能抹去KKT系统中的对偶可行性。我们构造了$C^\infty$目标函数和由香农熵镜像下降在非负正交限$\R_+^n$（对于每个$n\geq 3$）和概率单纯形$\Delta_n$（对于每个$n\geq 4$）上生成的有界序列，使得在每种情况下，累积点集是一个光滑边界圆，包含一个非空相对开弧的非KKT点。
tldr: 本文通过构造反例，证明熵镜像下降在适当步长下，其有界序列的累积点不必是KKT平稳点，打破了长期存在的假设。
en_tdlr: This paper constructs counterexamples showing that accumulation points of bounded entropic mirror descent sequences need not be KKT stationary under proper stepsizes, overturning a longstanding assumption.
